gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-multani: Vintage swagger, loud and sure of itself. Woodgod's tall lowercase nearly meets its capitals, and Noto Sans Multani follows on a plain sans footing with a lofty x-height and a wide gap at the e terminal.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Woodgod comes in commanding and a bit vintage, with a wide channel running into every bowl. Noto Sans Myanmar sits below in sans-serif form, a thick, heavy-looking strip of text with a broad opening on the c.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-nabataea: Noto Sans Nabataean stands its lowercase almost cap-tall, with wide-open s curves and a contemporary feel. Noto Sans Nabataean is the quiet strength here, because Woodgod's own tall lowercase echoes that height from above.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-nag-mund: Noto Sans Nag Mundari reads modern, its lowercase rivaling the capitals. Woodgod is the one for commanding, vintage display with wide channels into each bowl, while the sans-serif body handles the steady work with half-unwrapped c and s shapes.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-nandinag: Noto Sans Nandinagari feels approachable and generous. Under Woodgod's vintage, commanding display, its big lowercase body and short ascenders would carry a long page with openings that stay friendly at every weight.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-newa: Woodgod's lowercase nearly climbs to its capitals. Noto Sans Newa takes over below with a clearly open e and tall bowls, so a long page of this sans would read modern and comfortably clear.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Contemporary through and through, this pairing sets commanding Woodgod against a towering x-height. Noto Sans Nushu is the strongest quality here, holding its terminals far from the stroke body while the sans stays modern.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Clean lines meet vintage muscle here, with Woodgod's wide channels into every bowl up top. Noto Sans Ogham brings wide gaps in the e and bold-looking lowercase from tall bodies, which is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: A wide channel into every bowl gives Woodgod its commanding, vintage voice, with tall lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals. Noto Sans Ol Chiki does the quieter job, holding curve tails back so words read as solid blocks.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-old-hung: Tall lowercase nearly reaching the capitals gives Woodgod a commanding, vintage stance, with wide channels running into every bowl. Noto Sans Old Hungarian's large open counters in a, e and s make the strongest quality.
